title: Congress.gov Notifications Congress.gov Enhancements for June of 2026
summary:
We are pleased to bring you the Congress.gov enhancements for June of 2026

Enhancement – House Roll Call Votes – 115th Congress

  • House roll call votes from the 115th Congress (2017-2018) are available to browse and search.
  • Use the House Roll Call Votes link in the Congressional Activity section of the Browse page to view a sortable list.
  • Learn more at About House Votes.

Enhancement – Legislation – Search

  • Search title types found on the Title Types field value list using the billTitleTypeId: search field to find legislation with a specific title type such as Short Titles as Enacted or Popular Titles.

Enhancement – Legislation – Enrolled Bill Text

  • Enrolled bill text tab displays USLM text by default when available.
